capabilities: Export notes as .epub to Kindle or PocketBook
Include embedded images, .md files, and .mp3 files in the export
Send the converted file by email via a PHP backend
Merge embedded images and notes into a single .md file (mergedown)
Configure Kindle, PocketBook, and sender email settings
extras: Privacy warning: if you do not self-host the PHP backend, your note content is sent to the author's server, though the author states it is not saved or read. Planned but unfinished features include .html and .pdf export and folder/file covers; the epub cover does not show on the Kindle bookshelf due to format limits.
intentEvidence: I was using Calibre and Pandoc-Export plugin, but I was wondering about a short way to export
motivation: The author wanted a one-command export that bundles embedded files, after using Calibre and the Pandoc-Export plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get notes onto an e-reader, so users had to run multi-step conversions through tools like Calibre or Pandoc.

summary: E-book export plugin that converts notes and their embedded images and notes into an .epub file and emails it to a Kindle or PocketBook.
